request: A few more concepts and other colour experiments; earthy heritage feel

variants.name: Palm-leaf folio
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a beautiful, professionally art-directed landscape brand exploration board for the exact name "Utkal Project". The exact approved tagline is "Rediscover Utkal. Reimagine Odisha." Keep both easily readable. This project combines a living encyclopedia, heritage, belonging and future opportunity in Odisha. The user wants a distinctly earthy heritage feeling, with material warmth and contemporary clarity. Not a generic luxury hotel, government department or corporate tech startup.
Board format: spacious landscape 3:2 composition with a small direction title, a large primary logo/name/tagline, then three compact applications labelled "Website", "Avatar", "Story card". Header sample uses the logo/name/tagline and just "Explore  Stories  About". Avatar uses the symbol alone. Story card uses exact headline "People. Places. Possibilities." and the brand, with restrained abstract material or pattern imagery, not a made-up documentary photograph. Across the bottom show three small consistent copies of THIS SAME logo in alternative palette combinations: "Clay & indigo", "Forest & laterite", "Copper & charcoal", so symbol choice and colour choice can be judged separately. Include a short main-palette row of five swatches with exact hex labels. Small footer "Concept for review".
Wordmark: refined, sturdy serif with modest calligraphic character and an approachable editorial feel; avoid repeating the dramatically oversized high-contrast fashion serif of earlier alternatives. Heritage through form, rhythm and material sensibility. Background may have extremely subtle natural-paper texture; all logos themselves must have crisp solid silhouettes that could become one-colour marks. Generous negative space, no distressed grunge, metallic effects, bevels, gradients, faux aging or torn edges. Concept reference only, not fabricated antiquity. No religious figure, official seal, sacred symbol, invented Odia text, trademark sign or borrowed traditional motif. All ornament must be an original contemporary design. No boat/book-sail symbol and no complex UP or UTP monogram. Spell Utkal correctly, never Utkala.
Alternative palette definitions for bottom tests: Clay & indigo uses terracotta #994B35 and deep indigo #273B4C on unbleached paper #F0E4CF; Forest & laterite uses palm green #364B3A and laterite #7C3F2D on rice ivory #F4ECD9; Copper & charcoal uses copper #A26548 and charcoal #302E2B on limewash #ECE5D9.
Direction title: "C / Palm-leaf folio". Primary palette: terracotta #994B35, deep indigo #273B4C, unbleached paper #F0E4CF, muted brass #B78B42, warm ink #322B27.
Symbol idea: an original compact abstract folio emblem, three gently tapering horizontal leaf-like slats, a simple central binding detail or deliberate negative-space opening, a quiet reference to the act of preserving knowledge on leaves. It must read as a human-made archive / unfolding knowledge, not a tropical leaf plant, hamburger icon or winged book. Build a memorable simple silhouette, some asymmetrical handwritten warmth balanced with robust spacing. This is a contemporary metaphor, not a replica of a historic manuscript. Use indigo for primary lettering and terracotta for emblem. Thin original etched-line ornament may appear in the story card, but do not invent any writing. Strong earthy material identity, credible literary culture.
